map.锚杆长度 L 按塌落拱高度估算（一般为跨度的 1/3~1/4，且不小于 2m）；: The bolt length L is estimated from the height of the caving arch (generally 1/3~1/4 of the span and not less than 2 m);
map.锚杆间距 S 通常取 0.8~1.5m，且 S ≤ L/2；: The bolt spacing S is usually 0.8~1.5 m, with S ≤ L/2;
map.喷射混凝土厚度 t 按围岩级别取 5~25cm；: The shotcrete thickness t is 5~25 cm depending on the surrounding rock grade;
map.实际设计须结合围岩力学参数、地应力及监控量测数据综合确定。: The actual design must be determined comprehensively from rock mechanical parameters, in-situ stress and monitoring measurement data.
map.💡 本工具仅给出经验参考值，具体支护参数应按《公路隧道设计规范》或《铁路隧道设计: 💡 This tool gives empirical reference values only; the actual support parameters should be determined according to the Code for Design of Highway Tunnels or the Code for Design of Railway Tunnels, combined with numerical simulation.
map.📚 深度解析：隧道支护参数设计: 📚 In-depth analysis: Tunnel Support Parameter Design
Bolt length: L = coefficient × excavation span B, with the coefficient increasing by rock grade (grade I 0.20, II 0.25, III 0.30, IV 0.35, V 0.40, VI 0.45), and not less than 2.0 m; the result is given to one decimal place.
map.锚杆间距：S=min(L/2, 级别上限)——Ⅰ~Ⅱ级上限 1.5 m、Ⅲ级 1: Bolt spacing: S = min(L/2, grade upper limit) — 1.5 m for grades I–II, 1.2 m for grade III and 1.0 m for grade IV and above, laid out in a staggered (quincunx) pattern; the poorer the rock, the closer the spacing.
map.厚度按级别取 5/8/12/18/22/25 cm（Ⅰ~Ⅵ级）；每延米锚杆数量=: thickness by grade is 5/8/12/18/22/25 cm (grades I–VI); the number of bolts per metre = ceil(support perimeter ÷ S²), where the support perimeter is approximated as 2 × (B + H), and multiplying by L gives the total bolt length per metre; support recommendations are given by grade as combinations (grades I–II local bolts + thin shotcrete, grades III–IV systematic bolts + mesh + shotcrete, grades V–VI systematic bolts + double mesh + steel-fibre shotcrete plus steel arches where needed).
map.算例：12×8 m 断面在六个围岩级别的支护参数: Worked example: support parameters for a 12 × 8 m section in six rock grades
map.取 B=12 m、H=8 m（支护周长≈2×(12+8)=40 m）：Ⅰ级 L=: Take B = 12 m and H = 8 m (support perimeter ≈ 2 × (12 + 8) = 40 m): grade I L = 12 × 0.20 = 2.4 m, S = min(1.2, 1.5) = 1.2 m, shotcrete 5 cm, ceil(40 ÷ 1.44) = 28 bolts per metre, total length 67.2 m, recommended local bolts + thin shotcrete; grade II L = 3.0 m, S = 1.5 m, shotcrete 8 cm, 18 bolts, 54.0 m; grade III L = 3.6 m, S = 1.2 m, shotcrete 12 cm, 28 bolts, 100.8 m, recommended systematic bolts + mesh + shotcrete; grade IV L = 4.2 m, S = 1.0 m, shotcrete 18 cm, 40 bolts, 168.0 m; grade V L = 4.8 m, S = 1.0 m, shotcrete 22 cm, 40 bolts, 192.0 m; grade VI L = 5.4 m, S = 1.0 m, shotcrete 25 cm, 40 bolts, 216.0 m, with grades V–VI recommended as systematic bolts + double mesh + steel-fibre shotcrete plus steel arches where necessary.
map.锚杆长度用「系数×跨度」算，能保证安全吗？: Is it safe to compute the bolt length as "coefficient × span"?
map.这是工程类比法的经验取值，用于初选参数与工程量估算，不能替代设计验算。锚杆长度需: This is an empirical value from the engineering analogy method, used for preliminary parameter selection and quantity estimation; it cannot replace design verification. The bolt length must ensure the anchored section reaches deep enough into stable rock (generally not less than 0.5~1.0 m) and satisfy checks based on the suspension theory or the composite arch theory; special conditions such as shallow cover, unsymmetrical loading, fault fracture zones and swelling rock must be calculated specifically by the design unit, with longer bolts or cables where necessary.
map.每延米锚杆数量为什么按 ceil(周长÷间距²) 计算？: Why is the number of bolts per metre computed as ceil(perimeter ÷ spacing²)?
map.工具把支护面近似为按 S×S 网格布点的展开面，用周长 2×(B+H) 作单延米: The tool approximates the support surface as an unfolded plane with bolts laid out on an S × S grid, using the perimeter 2 × (B + H) as the unfolded width per metre, so bolts per metre = ceil(perimeter ÷ S²), rounded up so no position is missed. This is a simplified estimate: with an actual staggered layout adjacent rows are offset by half a grid, so the count differs slightly, and the spacing at the arch and the sidewalls may also be set separately, so quantity checks should follow the construction drawings.
